profile.headline: Senior Principal Architect
profile.summary: Innovative and results-driven software engineer with two decades of experience. Expert in designing scalable, high-performance software solutions with a strong focus on integrating third-party APIs and implementing asynchronous data processing. Skilled in developing robust architectures that enhance system interoperability and efficiency. Adept at leading cross-functional teams, mentoring engineers, and driving technical strategy to solve complex integration and data challenges.

positions.title: Principal Software Architect
positions.description:
* Led the architecture and development of scalable platforms enabling seamless integration with major social media networks and third-party tools, enhancing client engagement capabilities.
* Designed and implemented asynchronous data processing pipelines to efficiently handle large volumes of social and user-generated data, improving system responsiveness and analytics accuracy.
* Integrated diverse third-party APIs to extend platform functionality, facilitating real-time social media monitoring, content management, and engagement workflows.
* Mentored engineering teams on best practices for API integration, asynchronous processing, and performance optimization in high-volume environments.
* Collaborated with product teams to define technical strategies for delivering innovative digital marketing and community engagement solutions.
* Partnered with social media platforms to develop new APIs to allow customer engagment while protecting user privacy
* Designed and implemented modular microservices to decompose a monolithic architecture and improve scalability, flexibility, and deployment velocity

positions.title: Product Architect
positions.description: Design and build a software platform which allows enterprise companies to manage their social media presence from a central location.
